name: Waitt Foundation Rapid Ocean Conservation (ROC) Grants
summary: Small, fast-turnaround grants for six-month projects on sustainable fishing and marine protected areas in island nations that partner with the Blue Prosperity Coalition, reviewed monthly.

geography.label: Blue Prosperity Coalition partner countries: Azores, Bermuda, Federated States of Micronesia, Fiji, Samoa, Tonga, Vanuatu

status.quote: There are no deadlines for submitting an application.

applicant_types.quote: Affiliation - Applicant must maintain affiliation with an academic institution or NGO for the duration of the grant project.

geography.quote: Funding is currently restricted to projects in countries with Blue Prosperity Coalition partnerships.

access.quote: Submit an application through our website by clicking the "Apply Now" button at the bottom of this page.

window.quote: Proposals are reviewed monthly on a rolling basis, although some applications may take additional time to evaluate.

amount.quote: We will review proposals for grants up to $20,000.
